_about: Banks for dungeon/life/grooming.py: how a companion's looks change over time. Hair colours (kind colour: the shade itself; highlights: added over their own colour; over: a two-tone or dyed look said after the hair), cuts (length is a stage of grooming.LENGTHS; who f, m or any; era modern or any), nail looks, glasses frames and facial hair styles. Every entry is visible wording a picture model can draw: shapes and colours, never damage. Tone mild entries are what I want an easy life keeps to.
